label: Repository
intent: The repository is opened and leafed through. Light: a page edge flips across from the fore-edge toward the spine, accelerating, and fades into the spine; the bookmark ribbon is swept aside as it passes, swings back past its rest and settles. Strong: three pages riffle across in quick succession, the ribbon is swept further and held aside until the last page passes, then falls back and settles in two swings. The book itself never moves.

page-1.//: hidden at rest: a turning page's free edge, drawn at the fore-edge and swept toward the spine

page-2.//: Strong only: the second page of the riffle

spine.//: in Solid it lies inside the cover fill, as in v1

cover.//: v1 Solid: the cover filled from its rim to past the spine, with the page area left open (r 1.4), one bridged subpath

motion.//: Set 31's visual check needs the page area open at 32 px in every frame: the page edges stay 1 unit clear of its top and bottom.
